paite: TOUPA'N Aigupta gam ah Mosi leh Aaron kiang ah thu agen hi.
heading: Paikan

paite: Hiai kha noute a dia khate kipatna ahi ding. Noute a ding in kum khat a akha masapen ahi ding hi.
Israel omkhawmte kiang ah thu gen in, hiai kha ani sawm ni in apipute inkuan dungzui zel in, michih in amah a ding in belamnou akilak chiat dia, inn khat zel a ding in belamnou khat zel.
Belamnou khat a dia inkuan atawm luatleh, ami phazah dungzui in amah leh a-inn zom a-invengte a toh lakhawm hen. Michih in akham ding bang zel in belamnou na sim ding uhi.
Na belamnou uh gensiatbei, apa kum khat a upa ahi dia; belamhon lak hiam kelte lak a pan in hiam na lakhe ding uhi.
Huai kha mah ani sawm-le-li tan na kem ding ua; nitaklam in Israel khawmpi omkhawmte'n agou ding uhi.
Asisan na la ding ua, anekna ding uh inn kongkhak biang khuam nihte ah leh kongkhak tung ah na tat ding uhi.
Huai zan in sa mei a haimin, tanghou silngou soh louh toh na ne ding uhi; lou kha toh na ne ding uhi.
Sialnek kei unla, tuihuan het kei un, alutang, akhete leh asungkua toh mei ah na haimin zaw ding uhi.
Azingchiang tan in bangmah na valsak kei ding uhi. Azingchiang tan a omlaite mei in na haltum ding uhi.
Hichibang in na ne ding uhi. Na kawng uh gaksa in, na khedap uh na khe ua bulhsa in, na khut ua na chiangkhunte uh tawisa in na kin nek ding uhi. Hiai TOUPA Paikan Ankuang ahi.
Tuzan chiang a Aigupta gamsung tawnsuak a, Aigupta gam a piang masa teng, mi leh ganta that ding ka hih ziak in, Aigupta pathiante tengteng siatna ding in ka vaihawm ding hi: Kei TOUPA ka hi.

Sisan tuh noute a ding in na omna innte uah chiamtehna ahi ding. Sisan ka muh chiang in, ka hon paikan ding, Aigupta gam ka gawt chiang in, nou hon hihse ding in na tung uah hiai gawtna a-om kei ding hi.
Hiai ni noute a ding in theihgige ahi ding. Na khang na khang un TOUPA kiang a ankuangluina in na nei ding ua; tangtawn in dan thuseh a ankuangluina in na nei ding uhi.

"Ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding ua; ani masapen ni ngei in na innte ua pan in silngou na koihmang ding uhi. Ani masapen ni a kipan ani sagih ni tan, tanghou silngou soh ne peuhmah, huai mi Israel a pan satkhiak ding ahi ngal a.
heading: Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuang

paite: Ani masapen ni in kikhopna siangthou a-om dia, ani sagih ni in noute a ding in kikhopna siangthou a-om ding. Huai nite in nek bawl chih louh ngal nna sep louh himhim ding ahi. Nekbawl kia na hihthei ding uh.
Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina na tang ding ua; hiai ni mah a Aigupta gam a kipan na mite ka pikhiak ziak in. Huaiziak in tangtawn in na khang un dan thuseh in hiai ni na tang ding uh ahi.
Akha khatna ah, huai kha ani sawm-le-li ni, nitaklam a kipan huai kha nitaklam ani sawmnih-le-khat matan in, tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uhi.
Na insung uah ni sagih sung silngou muh in a-om ding ahi kei. Kuapeuh silngou soh ne, huai mi ngei mikhual hiam hi in, agamsung a piang hitaleh Israel omkhawmte a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
Silngou soh bangmah na ne ding uh ahi kei. Na tenna peuhmah uah tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding uhi," achi hi.
Mosi in Israel upate asamsak a, akiang uah, “Na inkuan dungzui zel un belamnou kaikhia in kilak unla, Paikan Belamnou gou un," achi hi.
heading: Paikan Masa

paite: "Hissop gaklop na la ding ua, belkuang sung a om sisan ah na diah ding ua, belkuang sung a om sisan in kongkhak biang khuam tuak leh kongkhak tung na zep ding uhi. Zingsang masiah na lak ua kuamah a- inn kongkhak ah ava pawtkhe ding ahi kei;

Aiguptate that dia TOUPA hong paisuak ding ahih ziak in. Kongkhak tung a leh kongbiang khuam nihte a sisan amuh chiang in TOUPA'N huai kongkhak apaikan dia, hon that ding in na insung uah hihsemi hong lut aphal kei ding hi.
Tangtawn in na tapate uh a ding leh noute a ding in dan thuseh in hiai thil na tang ding uh ahi.
Huan achiam bang a, nou ahon piak ding gam na tun chiang un, hichi ahi ding a, hiai biakna thilzek in na nei ding uh ahi.
Hichi ahong hi ding a, na tate un na kiang ua, hiai biakna thilzek bang na chihna uh ahia? ahon chih chiang un,
'Aiguptate athah a, ei innte atatkhiak lai a, Aigupta gam a Israel suante innte paikanpa, TOUPA paikanna theihgigena ahi, " na chi ding uh. Huchi in mite'n alu uh akunsak ua abeta uhi.
Israel suante apaimang ua, TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron thu apiak bang in ahih ua, huchibang in amau leng ahihta uhi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, zankim lai in TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a piang masa tengteng, alaltutphah tung a tu Pharaoh ta masapen a pan suangkul sung a om sal ta masapen tan in, ganhon nou masapen teng toh athatta hi.
heading: Piang Masate Sihna

paite: Huchi in zan in Pharaoh athou a, amah leh asikhate leh Aigupta tengteng, Aigupta gamsung teng ah kahna thupitak a-omta a; inn khat mahmah mi khat sihlouhna a-om louh ziak in.
Zan in Mosi leh Aaron asamsak a, "Thou unla, ka mite lak a pan paikhia un. Noute gel leh Israel suante pai un. Na gensa bang un, TOUPA nna va sem un.
Na bawnghonte uleh na ganhonte uh leng, na chih bang un, pi unla, paikhia un. Huchi in kei leng hon vualzawl un," achita hi.
Kintak a gam a pan asawlkhiak theihna ding un Aiguptate'n mite anoh mahmah ua, "Si khin vek ding i hi uh," achih ziak un.
Mite'n atangbuang uh silngou soh ma in ala ua, aliangzang uah atangbuang haihnate uh puan a khihsawn in.
Mosi thu bang in Israel suante a-omta ua; Aiguptate dangka suangmantam leh dangka-eng suangmantam leh puansilh angen uhi.
Aiguptate mitmuh in TOUPA'N mite deihsakna apia a, adeih bang un huai thilte akiang uah apia uhi. Huchi in Aiguptate alok uhi.
Israel suante Rameses a pan Sukkoth atung ua, numei leh naupangte sim louh pasal ngen khe a pai nuaiguk ahi uhi.
heading: Israelte'n Aigupta Anusia Uh

paite: Mikihelte'n leng bawnghonte, ganhonte leh ganta tampi petmah toh amaute azuitou uhi.

Aigupta gam a kipan apuakkhiak uh tangbuangte mek in silngou soh louh tanghou abawl ua, amaute Aigupta gam a kipan kintak a hawlkhiak a om, akizekaisak theih louh ziak un, atanghou uah silngou asoh man kei ua, lamkal a nek ding leng abuaipih man kei uhi.
Huchibang in Aigupta gam a teng, Israel suante taam sung kum zali-le-sawmthum ahi.
Kum zali-le-sawmthum bei in hichi ahong hi a, huai ni ngei in hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta gam a pan TOUPA mi tengteng apaikheta uhi.
Aigupta gam a kipan amau apikhiak ziak in TOUPA a ding in huai zan zahtak petmah a tan ding ahi. Hiai TOUPA zan Israel suante'n akhang-akhang a, pilvangtak a atan ding uh ahi.
TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron kiang ah, "Hiai Paikan Ankuang zat ding a dan thuseh ahi. Mikhual in hiai anek louh ding ahi.
heading: Paikan Toh Kisai Dante

paite: Himahleh michih sikha sum a leisa, azek na sum nung in hiai ane thei ding hi.
Gamdangmi leh sikha goihmi in hiai ane ding ahi kei hi.
Inn khat a nek ding ahi; inn polam ah sa, abangmah na lathang ding uh ahi kei. Aguh leng na hihtan ding uh ahi kei.
Israel omkhawmte tengteng in hiai azuih ding uh ahi.

Na kiang ua mikhual a-om a, TOUPA a dia Paikan Ankuang a-um dingleh, pasalte zek sum ding ahi, huai khit chiang in hong pai nai uhenla, um uhen. Amah gamsung a piang bang ahi ding; zeksum louh mi in anek louh ding ahih ziak in.
Khotual mi a ding leh na lak ua mi khual taam a ding in dan khat a-om ding ahi," achi hi.
Huchibang in Israel suan tengteng in ahih uhi. TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron thu apiak bang in ahih uhi.
Huai ni mah in hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante apawlpi in apikheta hi.
